k:写.mnemonic: A baby in a cradle (勹) with exactly its father's forehead (冖). Everyone leaning over the cradle says the child is a perfect small version of him. Copy (be photographed, describe).

k:著.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) heaped on someone (者): bouquets are thrown at the author as she walks on stage, because her book has made her famous everywhere. Renowned (publish, write, remarkable).

k:眼.mnemonic: An eye (目) that is stubborn (艮): in a staring contest it refuses to blink or look away, until the whole round ball of it bulges out. Eyeball.
k:眼.hint: The eye that will not blink.

k:将.mnemonic: A map lies on a plank (爿) table. One hand points at it like a claw (爪) while the other takes a measurement (寸) of the march ahead. This is the man who gives the orders. Commander (leader, general, admiral).
k:将.hint: Pointing and measuring at the map table.

k:誰.mnemonic: Something in the dark coop says (言) a word, and it is only a turkey (隹). The startled farmer lifts his lantern and calls out the question. Who (someone, somebody).
k:誰.hint: A voice in the turkey coop.

k:苦.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) kept until they are old (古): the stale herbs brew into a tea so bitter that drinking a cup of it is an ordeal. Suffering (trial, worry, hardship).

k:護.mnemonic: A guard stands among the flowers (艹) at the garden gate. 'Who (誰) goes there?' he asks, and also (又) puts out a hand to stop you. Nothing gets past him to the house. Safeguard (protect).
k:護.hint: Guard in the flowerbed asking names.

k:老.mnemonic: A bent figure with long wispy hair on top, leaning forward on a crooked walking stick that hooks under him. Old man (old age, grow old).

k:奇.mnemonic: A big (大) man who can (可) squeeze through a keyhole. He can, you watch him do it, and you still have no idea how. Strange (strangeness, curiosity).

k:寄.mnemonic: Something strange (奇) is sitting under the roof (宀) of the porch. Curious neighbours gather at the gate and creep closer, step by step, for a better look. Draw near (stop in, gather, collect).

k:志.mnemonic: A samurai (士) standing on his heart (心): whatever he has set his heart on, he plants his feet and stands by it. Intention (plan, resolve, aspire).

k:池.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) washes over the desert and leaves behind one small hollow of still water, where a scorpion (也) comes each evening to drink. Pond (cistern, pool, reservoir).

k:週.mnemonic: A path (辶) running around the circumference (周) of the calendar: walk the full loop through seven days and you are back at Monday. Week.

k:便.mnemonic: A leader (亻) whose meetings grow late (更) every night has a shop built beside his office that never closes, so supper is always at hand. Convenience (facility, letter).

k:因.mnemonic: A fence (囗) put up around something big (大): the inspectors have fenced off the big wreck until they find out what made it happen. Cause (factor, depend on).

k:満.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water from the can goes over the flowers (艹) until both (両) pots are brimming and spilling onto the floor. Full (fullness, enough, satisfy).

k:酒.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of liquid sloshing out of a wine jar (酉). Whatever pours out of a wine jar, it is certainly not water. Alcohol (sake, liquor).
k:酒.hint: What sloshes from the wine jar.

k:雪.mnemonic: Rain (雨) that you can sweep off the doorstep with a broom (ヨ): it has frozen on the way down into soft white flakes. Snow.

k:段.mnemonic: A staircase of ten thousand (万) steps climbs to the dojo, and at each landing you are handed a better weapon (殳): one more step, one more rank. Grade (steps, stairs, rank).
k:段.hint: Each landing earns a better weapon.

k:香.mnemonic: A ripe stalk of grain with its head drooping over the sun: warm grain in sunlight gives off a sweet smell that drifts upward like smoke. Incense (smell, perfume).

k:旬.mnemonic: A day (日) tucked inside a cradle (勹): the newborn spends every day in the cradle for its first ten days before it is shown to the village. Decameron (ten-day period, season).

k:易.mnemonic: After a decameron (旬) of practice, ten days of twirling streamers (勿) from morning to night, the ribbon dancer finds the routine no trouble at all. Easy (simple, fortune-telling, divination).

k:傷.mnemonic: The leader (亻) said the climb was easy (易) and went up first without a rope. He came back down with his arm in a bandage. Wound (hurt, injure, pain).

k:災.mnemonic: A stream (巛) in flood above and a fire (火) burning below: the village is washed away and burnt down on the same day. Disaster (calamity, woe, curse).

k:浜.mnemonic: A soldier (兵) is posted exactly where a tsunami (氵) would come ashore. He stands watch on the sand all day, looking out to sea. Seacoast (beach, seashore).

k:談.mnemonic: Fire (火) piled on fire makes a campfire, and around it everyone has something to say (言). They talk the matter over late into the night. Discuss (talk, conversation, speech).

k:劇.mnemonic: On stage an actor in tiger stripes (虍) chases an actor dressed as a pig (豕) with a wooden knife (刂). The audience gasps at every turn. Drama (play).

k:羽.mnemonic: Two matching wings held side by side, each one showing a pair of short plumes slanting downward. Feathers.
